canonical_project: Agartala Smart City Data Centre (IT Bhavan, Indranagar)
notes: Inaugurated 5 Aug 2024 by Chief Secretary at IT Bhavan, Indranagar; claimed first Smart City Mission data centre in India with own fibre network (156 km); ~Rs 30 crore equipment, 1 PB primary / 1.9 PB secondary storage; city-scale facility, capacity in MW not published.
